fields.subject: Quality issue with tomatoes
fields.description: Some of the tomatoes in the last delivery were overripe. Please ensure better quality control.

fields.message: We apologize for the quality issue. We have reviewed our quality control process and will ensure this doesn't happen again. A credit will be applied to your next invoice.
Thank you for the quick response and resolution.

fields.subject: Late delivery inquiry
fields.description: Our scheduled delivery for tomorrow needs to be moved to an earlier time if possible. Can we reschedule to 8 AM?

fields.message: Let me check with the driver and get back to you shortly.
